topic: how much of every dollar of orders DoorDash keeps as its own revenue
storyAngle: DoorDash keeps a modest slice of each order, and the slice is growing because of ads.
doNotClaim: Net Revenue Margin is DoorDash revenue as a percent of Marketplace GOV (gross order value); NEVER say what share goes to restaurants or drivers.
Do not state any dollar split of a single order.

facts.claim: DoorDash full-year 2024 Marketplace GOV (total dollar value of orders on its marketplace) was $80.2 billion.
DoorDash full-year 2024 Net Revenue Margin (its revenue as a share of Marketplace GOV) was 13.4%, up from 12.9% in 2023, mainly from higher advertising.
say: about thirteen cents on the dollar
